answer: Clone keys flood the first-hour attest window. A newcomer is assigned a 9-cell knoll map and must plant 6 sable beacons over 18h: one proof every 3h, hash=sha256(pubkey||cell||slot) with 18 leading zero bits. Beacons post only in an 11-min oasis window at hours 4, 10, and 16. Stake is 8.7 POA for 5 days; a missed window costs 0.31 POA. A 150-key farm needs 900 distinct cells and 1305 POA locked. Peers recompute hashes and drop reused cells or overlapping slots. Late beacon after close slashes 3.8 POA and zeros weight 36h; duplicate cell burns 22%; under 4 beacons refunds 60% after 48h.
